Backend: 9/9 new pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_examsecure_v3.py all PASS (grant mode keeps counter, allowance makes new limit = max_violations + extra, re-locks exactly at new limit; reset mode zeros violations & allowance; empty body defaults to reset; teacher message stored on session.teacher_message {text,at,read:false}, unlocked event detail includes '« message »'; student /student/message-read marks read:true and logs message_read event; empty/whitespace message not stored; POST /student/event response returns {violations,status,counted,limit}; optional seconds field persisted on event ~12.4). Backend regression: 45/45 all pass (incl 22 original + 14 v2). Frontend: full E2E through browser verified. Student /examen page: start-exam-btn -> exam-shell -> violations-indicator shows '0/2' then '2/3' after grant+1. Real ClipboardEvent paste dispatch is blocked and logs paste_attempt with detail « copied content from clipboard »; copy dispatch logs copy_attempt. locked-overlay appears at violations==max. Teacher POSTs unlock {mode:'grant',extra:1,message:'Dernier avertissement...'}. Student polling (5s) picks up unlock -> teacher-message-overlay with teacher-message-text matches exactly -> teacher-message-read-btn dismisses overlay, sets read=true, logs message_read event. Teacher Results page -> monitoring-student-card-0 -> SessionDetail shows activity-summary with all 8 tiles (activity-copy/paste/tab/app/fs/keys/ctx/away-time). Timeline (session-timeline) contains labels 'Coller bloqué' and 'Copier bloqué' with pasted text snippet. UnlockDialog accessible via unlock-session-btn / unlock-session-top-btn when session.status=='locked'; dialog contains unlock-mode-grant with unlock-extra-1 & unlock-extra-2, unlock-mode-reset, unlock-message-input (textarea, maxlen 500), unlock-confirm-btn.

issues: When paste_attempt is logged, the subsequent copy_attempt can capture the content of the toast ('Signalement 1/2 : A tenté de coller : «...»') because window.getSelection() reads from the DOM including the toast overlay text. Not a bug per se — the copy was still blocked — but the recorded 'copied text' is misleading. Consider filtering out the sonner toast container from getSelection or snapshotting selection before showing the toast.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L378 allowance formula: `max(0, s['violations'] - max_violations) + extra`. If a teacher locks a student with violations=5 and max=2, allowance becomes 5-2+1 = 4, so new limit = 2 + 4 = 6, meaning student has +1 remaining event — correct. But if max=2 and violations=2 and extra=1, allowance=0+1=1, limit=3, remaining=1 event. Verified by tests.

StudentExam.jsx L92-104 polls /student/session every 5s only while status=='locked'. If teacher unlocks with a message, the first poll detects status change and triggers showMessageIfAny. However once the student is already in_progress (not locked) and a teacher later re-sends a message via unlock (edge case: double unlock), the poll loop is not active so the message won't appear until the student reloads. Edge case only.

useAntiCheat emit() dedupe is 1500ms for ANY counted event (shared lastCountedRef). This means consecutive legitimate but distinct events (e.g., paste followed by copy within 1.5s) can be swallowed. In testing I had to add a 600ms wait between paste and copy dispatches, and still the copy went through only because 2000ms had elapsed. Consider per-type dedupe.

COUNTED_EVENTS set in server.py includes 'shortcut' but frontend keydown handler now only fires 'shortcut' for Ctrl+P/S/U (not Ctrl+V/C — those are handled as paste/copy_attempt). Alignment is correct per iteration note.
UnlockDialog message input maxLength 500 matches backend body.message Field(max_length=500). Good.
